findings: All 23 required controls recompute consistently: zero for untouched, 60°, 51 mm excursion, one-sample support loss, 60-sample topping loss, gripper bypass, mouth crossing, 239-sample dwell, unwithdrawn peel, six-sample overforce, collision damage, invalid shortcut, and both refinement-only native-zero cases; 0.5 for safe 120°; 1.0 for safe 165°, 180°, wrapped 210°→150°, 59-sample topping recovery, late withdrawal, five-sample overforce, alternate-arm/order, and mid-interval camera-floor cases. Partial first becomes available at 90° and full at 150°; there is no bonus. Timeout is zero unless the 240-sample eligibility dwell completes by native physics step 28,800.

Timing is internally consistent: 2,400 controls at 20 Hz equal 120 seconds; native grading is sampled at 240 Hz and refinement is separately replayed at 480 Hz. Eligibility, topping-loss, and overforce durations resolve respectively to 1.0 s, 0.25 s, and 0.025 s. Contact observables are explicitly fresh post-resolution physics-substep measurements.

The prior camera ambiguity is repaired: only fully completed 20 Hz intervals render and enter n; mid-interval termination adds no frame. Signed-separation reductions, deck gap versus normal load, worst-frame depth validity, and matched force-event refinement are also explicitly defined.

A material contradiction remains between artifacts/selected.json and artifacts/contract.json. The selection assigns zero for any “topping separation,” whereas the contract intentionally tolerates 1–59 consecutive detached 240 Hz samples and requires the 59-sample recovery control to score 1.0. The selected success condition must adopt the exact 60-consecutive-sample TOPPING_LOSS threshold, or the contract and controls must make any separation fail.

No input/runtime-api-preflight.json or input/pinned-runtime-sources snapshot is present. This does not independently invalidate the prospective specification because the contract explicitly leaves pinned API and AssetRegistry compatibility as an unverified later construction gate.
